Name: sdtest fixture
Author: sdtest
Description: Actions with known-good and known-bad onWillAppear/onWillDisappear behaviour, used to prove the lifecycle check detects what it claims to.

Actions.Name: Clean
Actions.Tooltip: Starts a timer in willAppear and clears it in willDisappear.

Actions.Name: Timer leak
Actions.Tooltip: Starts a silent timer in willAppear and never clears it. Only the handle count reveals it.

Actions.Name: Chatty leak
Actions.Tooltip: Keeps calling setImage for a key that has already disappeared.

Actions.Name: JS heap leak
Actions.Tooltip: Retains a large JS array per appear and never releases it.

Actions.Name: Heap leak
Actions.Tooltip: Retains a large buffer per appear and never releases it.
